Asobi 1.0.21 (build 2340) Nov 24, 2026

  • Live pictures. A live link from a grading Mac opens in its own window: File › Open Live Link…, a link pasted into Join a Review, or Open in Asobi Review on the live page. The picture is shown through Asobi's color like a Rec.709 movie, with its sound. Quality follows your connection (Auto) or picks Full, HD or Low, and full screen fades the bar away while the mouse is still.
  • Display warnings. When Night Shift or True Tone is changing the picture's color, an amber Display chip appears in the bar. It can turn them off while you review, and Asobi turns them back on when it quits. On an XDR display it suggests the HDTV Video (BT.709-BT.1886) preset for Rec.709 work. Settings › Interface › Display Warnings turns the chip off.
  • Asobi Live for grading Macs. File › Download Asobi Live… gets the sender that puts a grading Mac's picture and sound on a live link. It needs a license from the studio; Macs on the studio network get one by themselves.
Earlier updates

1.0.20 (build 2325) Nov 24, 2026

  • Kitsu comments in internal reviews. When a review is marked Internal Review, everyone in it sees its Kitsu comments, including people on the web page. Client reviews still keep them on the host's Mac unless Show Kitsu Comments to Guests is on.
  • Joining a review in progress. Someone who joins late now gets every comment on the right shot. A few could land on the shot they were leaving.
  • Next and previous comment across shots. In a cut movie, Command-] past a shot's last comment goes on to the next shot that has one, and Command-[ goes back the same way.

1.0.19 (build 2318) Nov 21, 2026

  • Kitsu comments are in date order. In This shot, a frame's notes from the review come first, in the order they were written, then its Kitsu comments, newest first.
  • Filter the notes. The filter button beside Export shows four pop-ups: Who, When, Version and From (this review or Kitsu). The list says how many notes it is showing, and Clear brings them all back. It works in This shot, Whole movie and the Kitsu tab, stays on this Mac, and exports still take every note.

1.0.18 (build 2315) Nov 21, 2026

  • The grade works on clips shown As on this Mac. The Grade panel used to do nothing there. Now the picture still looks exactly as macOS shows it until you grade, and the grade goes on top, for a quick check. For a fully managed grade, choose a preset in the Color pop-up.

1.0.17 (build 2307) Nov 20, 2026

  • Showcases no longer get stuck packaging. Some clips stopped for good on "Packaging it for streaming — 1 of 3" while their picture and sound were joined into one stream. They now finish, and if packaging ever stalls the showcase stops with a reason instead of waiting forever.

1.0.16 (build 2304) Nov 20, 2026

  • Showcases and web links no longer stall taking the sound. The clip's sound is read from the original once and reused, instead of up to three times, so a long movie on the server prepares much faster. The line under the bar shows the sound's progress, and if it stops moving for a minute the share goes on without it rather than waiting forever.

1.0.15 (build 2301) Nov 19, 2026

  • Frame.io sign-in no longer quits Asobi. Changing Adobe accounts on the sign-in page, or Adobe answering from the browser, could close Asobi without a word. It now finishes the sign-in or says why it didn't.

1.0.14 (build 2298) Nov 18, 2026

  • Guests Can Drive the Room. A new switch in the Review menu, under Guests Can Zoom the Room, while you host. Turn it off and people on the web link watch what you play: their play, steps, timeline, shot band and compare are greyed, and they stay on your clip and frame. They can still write notes, reply, draw and point. Turn it back on at any time. Stepping away or ending the review lets them drive again. Studio seats are not affected.
